observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'Fat' model.
SONY and PS4 logos are visible on the front of the device in photo 0.
A blue rectangular sticker is attached to the top right of the console.
No controllers (pads), cables, or game discs are visible in either photo.
The console is shown from a front-side angle and a top-down angle.

claims.evidence: No game discs or digital library screens are shown.
No controller is visible in the photos.
EA Sports FC 27 does not exist; the current series only reaches FC 25.

claims.claim: God of war 4, GTA 5, Spider man, Sekiro, Resident evil 2 remake
claims.evidence: No physical media or software lists are pictured.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and loading a game disc.

risks.risk: The '1 pad' may be missing, third-party, or have significant stick drift.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller and a video of it navigating the system menu.

risks.risk: The games may be digital accounts (which can be reclaimed) rather than physical discs.
risks.proof: Photos of the physical game discs or cases.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller (pad) and any included cables.
Photos of the 10 game discs or the console's digital library screen.
A short video of the console turned on and connected to a screen.
Clarification on 'FC 27' as this title has not been released.
response.reason: The seller claims a bundle including a controller and 10 games, but only photos of the console are provided. Furthermore, the mention of a non-existent game (FC 27) is a significant red flag that requires verification of the actual inventory.
